claims.statement: Tom Allen claimed to be an American citizen and said he would fight under American colors from then on.
claims.excerpt: Tom claims to bean American citizen, and will hereafter

claims.statement: Tom Allen fought Charley Gallagher on Tuesday, August 17, 1869, under American colors: a silk handkerchief with an American eagle, stars and two American flags.
claims.excerpt: the colors under which Tom fought on Tuesday last with Gallagher

notes: The colors item is a presentation of the handkerchief to the paper. 'Tom claims' is the paper's paraphrase, not a quote. The Balthasar Stark item is not about Allen.
